title: Hermes Kanban Gitter
description: Universal gitter scope validation gate for Hermes Kanban commit/push safety.

repo_path.description: Repository path (adapter-owned, not hardcoded in universal skill).

git_context.description: Git context before and after the operation.

remote.description: Remote name (e.g. origin). Adapter or task-specific.

remote_branch.description: Remote branch (e.g. refs/heads/main). Adapter or task-specific.

head_before.description: Commit hash before the commit. Null if no prior commit.

head_after.description: Commit hash after the commit. Null if commit not yet made.

files_to_commit.description: Explicit list of files to commit. Must be non-empty when commit_required is true.

files_to_exclude.description: Files or patterns to exclude from staging even if in working tree.

allow_artifacts.description: Whether artifact files (e.g. .json artifacts, reports) may be committed. Defaults to false.

allow_wiki_files.description: Whether wiki documentation files may be committed. Defaults to false.

allow_source_files.description: Whether source code files may be committed. Defaults to true.

commit_required.description: Whether a commit is expected for this task.

push_required.description: Whether a push is expected after commit.

message.description: Commit message. Required when commit_required is true.

body.description: Optional commit body or extended description.

safety.description: Safety flag overrides — all default false.

force_push_allowed.description: Whether force push is permitted for this gitter operation. Defaults to false.

github_issue_close_allowed.description: Whether this gitter operation may close a GitHub issue. Defaults to false.

pr_allowed.description: Whether this gitter operation may create a pull request. Defaults to false.

merge_allowed.description: Whether this gitter operation may merge a branch. Defaults to false.

direct_sqlite_allowed.description: Whether direct SQLite writes are permitted. Defaults to false.

gitter_allowed.description: Whether this gitter operation is allowed to proceed.

requires_operator_approval.description: Whether operator approval is required before proceeding.
